authority_basis.summary: Record the reduced localization map for the marked four-site node packet.

operations.title: The seven marked nodes generate the entire reduced vanishing lattice
operations.body: The seven nonpositive node basis vectors inject into Q^8/<r_total-parity> and have rank seven, hence map isomorphically onto the global vanishing lattice. The positive class is their signed combination, so the ordinary open quotient and reduced mapping cone vanish.

operations.title: Reduced four-site node localization rank audit
operations.body: The exact checker constructs the supported-to-global matrix in the seven-node basis, verifies rank seven, expresses the positive class in that basis, and obtains zero open quotient and cone ranks.

operations.title: Benincasa reports acyclicity of the reduced node localization cone
operations.body: Entry 1179: the seven marked node classes inject and span the entire rank-seven global lattice Q^8/<r>. The positive node is their exact total-parity signed combination. Hence the ordinary marked-complement quotient and reduced node cone are zero. Any surviving object must be in the incidence-depth Čech/Kato extension or a physical relative-chain pairing, not the reduced node grade.
